taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: NuGet package source mapping and transitive restore trust
controls.source_trace: Determine which source can satisfy each direct/transitive package ID and whether fallback or merged config defeats the intended mapping.
controls.implementation_branch: Determine whether package source mapping covers direct and transitive IDs, and which existing cache/lockfile affects the restore. A cache hit may conceal the source that a clean restore would select. An intentionally mirrored trusted source is not dependency confusion; show an unintended producer selected for the protected package identity without publishing a package.
controls.operational_method: Resolve merged nuget.config files including clear elements and source names. For a package ID, exact mapping is more specific than prefix, a longer prefix is more specific than a shorter one, and wildcard is least specific; equal applicable mappings may still allow multiple sources. Keep global-packages cache hits separate from fresh source resolution. Compare one internal ID and a similarly prefixed external ID using a disposable cache and supplied or isolated restore metadata, not untrusted package execution.
controls.controlled_verification: Use inert local feeds and package coordinates; compare intended source mapping with a controlled duplicate/fallback without executing package hooks.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Two configured feeds do not prove confusion; an unused package name or failed restore is not a selected untrusted artifact.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind package families to intended sources and verify direct/transitive restore plus locked updates.
